decisions.decision: The committee agreed on its charge: staff work to assess current and future maintenance and capital costs for Town-owned buildings; evaluate market potential of surplus buildings; recommend a course of action and assist in renovation, demolition or sale as directed by the Town.
decisions.quote: it was agreed that the committee saw the following as our charge:

decisions.decision: Status agreed for T.C. Passios & Brooks House: no action, School Committee to decide boundaries and timing of any excess property.
decisions.quote: t.c. passios & brooks house - no action - school committee to decide the boundaries and timing of any excess property.

decisions.decision: Status agreed for Ritter Building & Old Primary School: no action, awaiting any changes to Village Zoning Bylaw affecting use and market.
decisions.quote: ritter building & old primary school - no action - awaiting any changes to village zoning bylaw that would affect potential use and market.

decisions.decision: Status agreed for Town Hall: committee reviewing renovation plans and costs for current capital needs and potential future use.
decisions.quote: town hall - reviewing renovation plans and costs for current capital needs and potential future use.

decisions.decision: Any discussions with FLACC beyond mutual interest in continuing to talk wait until the School Committee formalizes its property transfer plans.
decisions.quote: it was agreed that any discussions beyond that of mutual interest in continuing to talk would wait until the school committee formalized their property transfer plans.

decisions.decision: Plan to tour the Old Primary School and other Town Halls by video using Town Public Access resources was supported; members agreed to watch the videos individually or as a group and discuss at a future meeting.
decisions.quote: this plan of action was supported, and committee members agreed to watch the videos as a group or individually and then discuss at a future meeting.
